name: Spell modifier mutant owned by a harness dummy aura
contract: The spell_mod_mutant action gives its player-scoped percent modifier an owner aura, Dummy Aura - Target: Any - Permanent 100523 (Spell.dbc on the server set: Effect[0] 6 with EffectApplyAuraName[0] 4, DurationIndex 21, ProcCharges 0, ProcFlags 0, SpellFamilyName 0, referenced by no script or CoA code), so Player::ApplyModToSpell can register it inside a spell. Sacred Restraint 102208 lasts 60000 ms (DurationIndex 3). A +100% duration mutant on 102208 is set before Testament of Strength 300514 is learned and cast; the cast applies 102208 through AscensionTemplarAbilities.cpp, inside a Spell, and the applied aura lasts 120000 ms. Removing the owner aura releases the modifier: the duration readback returns to 60000 ms and no mutant stays active.

steps.label: The owner aura is on the player
Sacred Restraint duration readback is doubled
The cast applies Sacred Restraint for the doubled duration
Removing the owner aura releases the mutant
Sacred Restraint duration readback is back to the DBC value
